test_title: PYST 14: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 03 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which among the community-focused transparency initiatives did the Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh police introduce in September 2025?

options.text: Police Outreach Day' to resolve neighborhood safety concerns
Public Accountability Meet' releasing monthly action reports
Vadi Samvad Diwas' allowing citizens to engage directly with investigators
Jan Sunwai Sabha' for direct citizen-police dialogue

solution:
The correct answer is __**Vadi Samvad Diwas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vadi Samvad Diwas** was introduced by the **Ghaziabad Police, Uttar Pradesh**, in **September 2025** as a community-focused transparency initiative aimed at building trust between citizens and the police.
 
• The initiative allows citizens to engage directly with **investigators** to discuss and resolve their cases transparently and effectively.
 
• This program ensures **accessibility** and **accountability** in investigations by providing a platform for individuals to interact with police officials face-to-face.
 
• The initiative specifically focuses on **case updates**, addressing public grievances, and ensuring citizens' concerns are heard without bureaucratic hurdles.
 
• **Public engagement** through such initiatives helps to strengthen **community-police relations** and fosters a sense of mutual trust and cooperation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Police Outreach Day**:

 
 
• This initiative involves organizing community events where citizens can discuss **neighborhood safety concerns** and seek solutions collaboratively with local law enforcement.
 
• While it aims to improve community relations, it does not focus on individual case updates or direct investigator interaction, unlike **Vadi Samvad Diwas**.
 
 
 
• **Public Accountability Meet**:
 
 
• This involves the release of **monthly action reports** by the police to keep the public informed about their activities and performance.
 
• It enhances transparency at a macro level, but it does not provide a platform for personal engagement or case-specific discussions with investigators.
 
 
 
• **Jan Sunwai Sabha**:
 
 
• This program allows direct interaction between citizens and police officers to address **grievances** and discuss broader issues affecting public safety.
 
• While it promotes dialogue, it is more general in nature and not specifically designed for investigator-citizen engagement on specific cases like **Vadi Samvad Diwas**.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Community Policing**:
 
 
• Community-focused initiatives like **Vadi Samvad Diwas** are part of broader efforts to integrate police services with public needs, ensuring **transparency, trust, and efficiency** in law enforcement.
 
• Such initiatives are aligned with global best practices in policing, promoting **citizen-centric governance**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Transparency in Law Enforcement:** Programs like **Vadi Samvad Diwas** reflect the importance of **transparent police operations** to ensure public confidence in law enforcement processes.
 
• **Community Engagement:** Effective policing depends on **active community participation**, with citizens acting as stakeholders in maintaining safety and security.
 
• **Trust Building:** Initiatives fostering direct dialogue between citizens and investigators reduce instances of mistrust and encourage **collaborative problem-solving**.
 
• **Global Best Practices:** Similar initiatives are seen in countries like the **United States** and **United Kingdom**, where community policing focuses on **partnerships and proactive problem-solving**.
